created_by_id.description: Filter to shared metrics created by the given user(s). Accepts a single user ID, or a JSON-encoded / comma-separated list of user IDs to match any of them.

event.description: Filter to shared metrics whose query references this event name — matched directly (an EventsNode) or via the step events of any action the metric references. For finding a reusable metric by what it measures; then confirm the match against each row's 'query'.

limit.description: Number of results to return per page.

metric_type.description: Filter by metric type. 'funnel' also matches legacy funnel metrics.

offset.description: The initial index from which to return the results.

tags.description: JSON-encoded list of tag names. Returns shared metrics carrying at least one of the given tags, e.g. `["growth", "checkout"]`.
